#!/usr/bin/env perl
use strict; use warnings;
use Carp;
use Data::Dumper;
use English qw(-no_match_vars);
use Getopt::Long qw(:config pass_through no_ignore_case);
use JSON;
use POSIX qw(floor);

# Define a few constants for readability
use constant {
	SUCCESS       => 10,
	TRUE          => 20,
	FAILURE       => 30,
	FALSE         => 40,
	EXISTS        => 50,
	NOT_FOUND     => 60,
	MIN_PER_HOUR  => 60,
};

# This script reports slurm usage for a requested user account. It
# Report usage for all account associations the user has as well as
# sub allocations specific to the user-project.
#
# All exits from main will either 'croak' or be successful.
# Script functions will return two arguments: a status code ($rc) and
# either a message or anticipated data in ($msg)

our $SLURM_QOS_FLAGS  = 'NoDecay, UsageFactorSafe';
our $SLURM_XPF        = 1000; # Expansion factor applied to allocated amount

our $SAM; our $SCTL;
BEGIN {
	# Make sure we can find our system commands
	$SAM = '/usr/bin/sacctmgr';
	croak "Required command not found: $SAM." if (! -e $SAM);
    $SCTL = '/usr/bin/scontrol';
	croak "Required command not found: $SCTL." if (! -e $SCTL);

}



MAIN: {
	my ($rc, $msg);

    ($rc, $msg) = get_opts();
    croak "$msg" unless ($rc == SUCCESS);
    my $requested_user = $msg;

    ($rc, $msg) = validate_slurm_user_account($requested_user);
    if ($rc == FAILURE) {
        print "Failed looking up user in Slurm database: $msg\n";
        exit FAILURE;
    }
    if ($rc == NOT_FOUND) {
        print "No slurm account association found for user $requested_user.\n";
        exit NOT_FOUND;
    }
    my $account_list = $msg;

    ($rc, $msg) = get_slurm_qos_billing($account_list);
    if ($rc == FAILURE) {
        print "Failed getting account QOS details: $msg\n";
        exit FAILURE;
    }

    ($rc, $msg) = get_account_descriptions($account_list);
    if ($rc == FAILURE) {
        print "Failed looking up user in Slurm database: $msg\n";
        exit FAILURE;
    }

    print_user_report($requested_user, $account_list);

    exit 0;

} ## End of Main


# Define a couple of helper functions for logging/error reporting
sub __FUNC__   { (caller 1)[3]; } # Returns the name of the current function/subroutine
sub __CALLER__ { (caller 2)[3]; } # Returns the name of the calling function/subroutine

# Looks for a user name in @ARGV. If none is provided uses the
# current script caller. Returns a user name on success. Calls
# print_usage if appropriate which exists directly.
sub get_opts {
    my %opt_hash;

    GetOptions(\%opt_hash,
		'u|user=s',
		'h|H|help|?',
	) or return(FAILURE, __FUNC__.": GetOptions failed: $CHILD_ERROR");

    return (SUCCESS, $opt_hash{u}) if $opt_hash{u};
    print_usage() if $opt_hash{h};
   
    if (scalar @ARGV == 0) {
        # No user name was provided use the executing user
        if ($UID == 0 or $EUID == 0) {
            return(FAILURE, "Root is not an allowed user");
        } else {
            my $user_name = getpwuid($EUID) or die "User $EUID not found: $CHILD_ERROR";
            return (SUCCESS, $user_name);
        }
    }

    print_usage();
} ## End of get_opts


# Checks to see if the user has a valid account in the Slurm database.
# Returns a list of associations, with their descriptions for the user,
# if found. NOT_FOUND if there is no matching user account with any
# associations, or FAILURE in case something unexpected goes wrong.
# The type of association will be appended to the accounts hash.
sub validate_slurm_user_account {
    my $user = shift;

    return(FAILURE, __FUNC__ . "No user name provided.") unless $user;

	# Look up account associations
	my $cmd = "$SAM -nP show assoc where user=$user format=qos";
	my $rc = `$cmd 2>&1`;
	return(FAILURE, __FUNC__ . ": $cmd returned error \"$CHILD_ERROR\" => $rc") unless $CHILD_ERROR == 0;
    
    # Remove any unwanted qos from the list before returing
   	my %accounts;
    foreach my $line (split /\n/, $rc) {
        next unless $line;
        next if $line eq 'noalloc'; #...Should not be any QOS for noalloc...
        chomp $line;
        if ($line =~ /^.+?-$user$/) {
            $accounts{$line}{type} = 'S'; # This is a sub-allocation
        } else {
            $accounts{$line}{type} = 'A'; # This is a regular account allocation
        }
    }
	return(NOT_FOUND, "No account associations for $user found in slurm database") unless scalar keys %accounts > 0;
    return(SUCCESS, \%accounts);

} ## End of validate_slurm_user_account


# Use scontrol to lookup the GrpTRESMins details for each
# account QOS. Get the current billing amount and usage.
# Append the amounts to the account_list hash.
sub get_slurm_qos_billing {
    my $account_list = shift;

    return(FAILURE, __FUNC__ . "No account list provided.") unless $account_list;

    ACCOUNT:
    foreach my $account (keys %{ $account_list }) {
        my $cmd = "$SCTL show assoc qos=$account flags=qos -o";
        my $rc = `$cmd 2>&1`;
        return(FAILURE, __FUNC__.": $cmd returned error \"$CHILD_ERROR\" => $rc") unless $CHILD_ERROR == 0;

        foreach my $line (split /\n/, $rc) {
            next unless $line;
            next unless $line =~ /^QOS=/;
            # This ouput appears to be space separated records
            # of variable content. Split on the spaces and look
            # for the grpTRESMins record to find billing and
            # useage data for the qos.
            my @fields = split '\s', $line;
            foreach my $grptres_record (@fields) {
                next unless $grptres_record =~ /^GrpTRESMins/;
                # Get the billing values from the GrpTRESMins 
                my ($allocated, $used) = $grptres_record =~ /\,billing=([\d\-]+)\(([\d\-]+)\)\,/sxm;
                $allocated = 0 unless $allocated;
                $used = 0 unless $used;
                $account_list->{$account}{allocated} = $allocated;
                $account_list->{$account}{used} = $used;
                next ACCOUNT;
            }
        } # End of scontrol output loop
    } # End of acccount loop

    return (SUCCESS, 'Success');

} ## End of get_slurm_account_usage


# Updates the account_list hash with the project description.
sub get_account_descriptions {
    my $account_list = shift;

    return(FAILURE, __FUNC__ . "No account list provided.") unless $account_list;

    # Grab the description for accounts (qos's do not have descriptions)
    foreach my $account (keys %{ $account_list }) {
        my $cmd = "$SAM -nP list account $account format=desc";
        my $rc = `$cmd 2>&1`;
        return(FAILURE, __FUNC__ . ": $cmd returned error \"$CHILD_ERROR\" => $rc") unless $CHILD_ERROR == 0;
        chomp $rc;
        $account_list->{$account}{description} = $rc;
    }
    return (SUCCESS, $account_list);
} ## End of get_account_descriptions
